asked: # Relaunch of axhub-mcp-service (Opus) The original build `axhub-mcp-service` died instantly on the weekly usage limit (Nov 2). Its full brief is at /root/axf-builds/axhub-mcp-service/.brief.md: read that file first and do exactly what it asks, on this branch (claude/axhub-mcp-service-2). Summary: add an `mcp` service type to axHub (connect outside MCP servers as axHub services) plus a `hostinger-mcp` service; writes need confirm. Check origin/main first and don't redo anything already landed. Brett OK'd auto-merge for this build: when tests pass, open the PR and land it. One session, no sub-agents. Never print secrets. Commit + push often. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.

steps.text: mcp connector: SSE fallback + policy hints + tests

result.summary: mcp services: SSE fallback, readOnlyNames/readOnlyTools/confirmWrites hints, hostinger-mcp service (off until hostinger-mcp-token); decision #112; PR #31
